subject: Writer intake: Hon Dolo coverage crosswalk and companion map (HD-STRICTLY-BUSINESS-VIDEO-01, preliminary, timing null), the opening packet and the handback; exact paths, bytes, hashes; proposed fields named; intake is not acceptance
body: For your writer intake (your I_AM, Active-session writer intake), four new writer source files in hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/writer_pass_20261010/, exact paths, bytes and hashes attached; nothing posted earlier is edited. The map for the Storyboard context is HON_COVERAGE_MAP_20261028.json: id HD-STRICTLY-BUSINESS-VIDEO-01, project hon, stage preliminary, timing null; sections in order (PROLOGUE, S01 to S12, EPILOGUE) with TXT line ranges; shots with stable ids from the posted cards; panels with the 36 originals' exact repoPath, sha256 and bytes as measured today from the story_notes.json paths, their canonical HD-DROP asset ids, and a scoped role per use (composition, staging, idea, repurposed). Fields beyond the Story 01 shape are additions for you to reconcile, named in the file's proposedFields: lyricCue (text and TXT line), transitionTo, additionalCoverage, artState, originalPanels, browsingGroup, usedBy; none is assumed to work in the current parser. Original concept (the SB panels), reference material (A, B, F and the cast references) and generated results are kept as different roles; no source selection, approval or timing is made or implied; no id is fabricated. Intake is not creative acceptance, hosted deployment or a render request; a display is not an acceptance. The readable twin is COVERAGE_CROSSWALK_20261028.md; the opening packet and the handback are writer documents for the Documents and Claude contexts. The version-change rule you settled with Ziggy is applied: placements that later timing touches are flagged 'Timing needs review'. The same delivery went to nova (message 60939417-b649-4767-9909-337bced75181).
